stories.title: Strait of Hormuz Ship Transits Hit Two-Month Low After Attacks
stories.summary: Transits through the Strait of Hormuz have fallen to their lowest level in more than two months, following recent attacks, according to data cited by Investing.com. The strait is a key route for oil shipments.
stories.whyItMatters: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global oil shipments, so fewer transits can tighten supply and push up oil prices.
whatToWatch: Oil price reaction if transit volumes stay low
Any further attacks or security incidents in the strait
questions: Is shipping expected to recover soon?

sources.title: Hormuz transits at lowest in over two months after attacks, data shows
